ppal-connect.description: Connect to Ableton Live and initialize Producer Pal. Call before other ppal-* tools when the user says use/connect to ableton.

ppal-context.description: The user's persistent context and memory. `scope` picks the layer, `action` reads or writes it. Prefer read before any write/delete.

action.description: read (default): project/global → the document; memory → the entry named `name`, or the whole index if no `name`. write: replace the document, or create/update the memory entry `name`. delete: remove the memory entry `name`.

content.description: Text to write — project/global: the whole document; memory: the entry body (one fact). Max 10000 chars.

description.description: Memory entry's one-line recall hook for the index — what's inside and when it's relevant. Required on a memory write.

force.description: Only when a write was skipped for dropping the whole document: true replaces it anyway.

name.description: Memory entry name (read/write/delete on scope:memory). Reuse a name to update, not duplicate.

scope.description: project (default): facts about THIS Live Set (genre, song structure), always in its context. global: who the user is across ALL projects (style, preferences, high-level goals), always in context. memory: durable facts and rules that matter only in CERTAIN situations, loaded on demand by name.

ppal-create-clip.description: Create MIDI or audio clip(s). Requires path — 't0/s0' for the session, and/or 't0' plus arrangementStart for the arrangement. For audio: use sampleFile (absolute path), otherwise omit sampleFile to create a MIDI clip. The sample defines an audio clip's region, so start/length/firstStart/looping are MIDI-only.

arrangementStart.description: arrangement clip bar|beat position(s), comma-separated for multiple (e.g., '1|1' or '1|1,2|1,3|3'). Song meter

auto.description: auto-play the new session clip(s) — worth setting whenever the user will want to hear what you made. play-scene launches the whole scene so the new clip stays in sync with the others (it restarts them; say so first). play-clip fires the clip alone

color.description: #RRGGBB for all, or comma-separated for each (cycles if fewer than positions)

firstStart.description: bar|beat playback start (looping clips, when different from start; clip meter)

gainDb.description: audio clip gain in decibels, 0 = unity (ignored for MIDI)

length.description: duration: Nbar (e.g., '4bar'), n<fraction> note value (e.g., 'n/4'), or Nbar+n<fraction> (e.g., '1bar+n/4'). Clip meter. MIDI only, default: next full bar after latest note. Audio clip length comes from the sample

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each (indexed: clip slots first, then arrangement)

notes.description: MIDI in bar|beat notation: v0-127 n<dur> [p0-1] note(s) bar|beat(s) - MIDI clips only

path.description: where the clip(s) go, comma-separated for multiple. 't<track>/s<scene>' is a clip slot; 't<track>' is that track's arrangement, which also needs arrangementStart; 't<track>/l<lane>' is a take lane on it and 't<track>/l+' appends a fresh one. All indices 0-based, so 't0/s0' is the first track's first scene (e.g., 't0/s0' or 't0/s0,t0/s2' or 't1' with arrangementStart)

pitchShift.description: audio clip pitch shift in semitones, supports decimals (ignored for MIDI)

sampleFile.description: absolute path to audio file - audio clips only

start.description: bar|beat position where loop/clip region begins (clip meter)

takeLaneName.description: name for a take lane this call creates (path 't<track>/l+')

warpMode.description: audio clip warp mode (ignored for MIDI)

warping.description: audio clips only. Omit and Live decides per its Loop/Warp Short Samples setting, often time-stretching the file to the tempo. false = play the file as rendered. The settled state comes back as `warping`

ppal-create-device.description: Create a native Live device (instrument, MIDI effect, or audio effect) on a track or inside a chain.

deviceName.description: device name, omit to list available devices

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each

params.description: applied after creation — array of {name, value}. name = param name or read-device id; value in display units (enum string, note name, number). For a Drum Rack, prefix the name with a pad path to address a pad's device, e.g. {name:'pC1/d0/sample', value:'<abs file path>'} loads a sample into pad C1 (auto-creates the pad's Simpler) — build a full kit in one call

path.description: insertion path(s), required with deviceName, comma-separated for multiple (e.g., 't0' or 't0,t1,t0/d0/c0')

ppal-create-scene.description: Create empty scene(s) or capture playing session clips.

capture.description: copy playing session clips instead of creating empty?

color.description: #RRGGBB for all, or comma-separated for each (cycles if fewer than count)

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each

sceneIndex.description: 0-based index for new scene(s), shifts existing scenes. Required when capture=false, optional when capture=true

color.description: #RRGGBB for all, or comma-separated for each (cycles if fewer than count)

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each

ppal-delete.description: Delete objects. Supports tracks, scenes, clips, devices, drum pads, and drum rack chains. Use id for most types; path for clips, devices, drum pads, and chains.

id.description: ID(s) to delete, comma-separated for multiple (must be same type)

path.description: path(s) to delete, comma-separated for multiple: session clips ('t0/s1'), devices ('t0/d1'), drum pads ('t1/d0/pC1'), one layer of a pad ('t1/d0/pC1/c1')

type.description: type of objects to delete; 'chain' removes one chain from a Drum Rack pad

ppal-duplicate.description: Duplicate an object. Supports tracks, scenes, clips, devices, and drum pads. Use count for multiple track/scene copies; arrangementStart or locator for clip placement, and toPath for the destination track, clip slot, device chain, or drum pad.

arrangementLength.description: duration: Nbar (e.g., '4bar'), n<fraction> note value (e.g., 'n/4'), or Nbar+n<fraction> (e.g., '1bar+n/4'); song meter. Shorter than the source trims the copy; longer tiles copies to fill the span (many clips, not one) — for a single clip use ppal-update-clip with looping false and notes for the full length

arrangementStart.description: arrangement bar|beat position(s) for clips/scenes, comma-separated for multiple (e.g., '1|1' or '1|1,2|1,3|1'). Song meter

count.description: number of copies (tracks/scenes only, ignored for clips/devices)

id.description: id of the object to duplicate

locator.description: arrangement locator ID(s) or name(s), comma-separated for multiple (e.g., 'locator-0' or 'Verse' or 'locator-0,Chorus')

path.description: source drum pad path instead of id, e.g. 't0/d0/pC1' (drum pads only)

routeToSource.description: tracks only (errors otherwise): the copy gets no clips or devices of its own and plays the source track's instrument (for MIDI layering/polyrhythms)

takeLaneName.description: name for a take lane this call creates (toPath 't<track>/l+')

toPath.description: destination(s), comma-separated for multiple. Clips: 't2/s1' = clip slot (track 2, scene 1), 't2' = track 2's arrangement (needs arrangementStart or locator, and a track matching the clip's MIDI/audio type), 't2/l0' = its first take lane and 't2/l+' appends a fresh one (MIDI only); omit for the source clip's own track. Devices: 't1/d0'. Drum pads: 't0/d0/pD1', required, and must be in the same rack as the source pad (id or path names the source). Cycles against arrangementStart when the lists differ in length

transforms.description: transform expressions (broadcast across copies; clips only); newline-separated for multiple. Use clip.index / clipseq() for per-copy variation

ppal-library.description: Search Live's browser library by name, tags, kind, or source. Defaults to audio samples (the only kind currently loadable into clips/Simpler); other kinds are discovery-only — pass kind explicitly to query them. Items from the user's configured sample folder always appear before Live's library items (sampleFolder is an explicit user choice); within each group, results sort by use_count desc by default.

action.description: search: filter library items (default) | listTags: enumerate available tags | listCategories: browse Live's category taxonomy (Sounds, Drums, Genres, …); pass category to drill into its tags | searchBatch: run many filtered searches in one call (e.g. build a drum kit), results grouped per query | listPlugins: list installed VST/VST3/AU plugins Live knows about (filter with query, vendor, format, deviceKind, subcategory) | findSimilar: rank samples by audio similarity to a seed sample (similarTo); combine with the search filters to constrain candidates | findDuplicates: group library samples with identical audio (re-shipped duplicates), scoped by the search filters

category.description: listCategories only: a top-level category name (from listCategories with no category) to drill into; returns its tag names, each usable as a tags filter

deviceKind.description: device classification filter (search + listPlugins; for listPlugins only instrument/audiofx apply)

inFolder.description: absolute folder path; returns only immediate children of that folder (search only). Composes with other filters. Case-insensitive (ASCII). Unresolvable paths return no results with a `reason` explaining the path wasn't found.

kind.description: content kind filter (search only; default: audio — the only kind loadable into clips/Simpler today, others are discovery-only). audio=.wav/.aif/.mp3/etc. samples | midi=.mid files PLUS MIDI Live clips (.alc), so it covers all MIDI content — the right kind for melody/chord ideas | live-clip=all .alc Ableton clips (MIDI+audio; each result reports subtype) | preset=instrument/effect presets | device-group=.adg device chains (racks) | m4l-device=.amxd Max for Live devices | live-set=.als project files | plugin=VST/AU specs and presets | image/video=media assets | folder=directory entries (a DB row type, distinct from source:sampleFolder)

queries.description: searchBatch only: array of query objects, each with the same filters as a single search (query, tags, kind, type, deviceKind, source, inFolder, sort, limit, verifyPaths) plus an optional label; results are returned in order, grouped per query (capped at 20)

inFolder.description: absolute folder path; immediate children only

label.description: label for this query's result group (defaults to its index)

query.description: name substring; use * as a multi-character wildcard

sort.description: sort order; defaults to use_count desc

tags.description: comma-separated tag names; results must match ALL listed tags

verifyPaths.description: stat each result's path and add pathExists (true/false) so you can skip files moved/deleted since Live last indexed

query.description: name substring (search: supports * as a multi-character wildcard, e.g. kick*acoustic; listPlugins: plain case-insensitive substring)

similarTo.description: findSimilar only: absolute path of a seed sample (e.g. a path from a prior search) to rank other samples by audio similarity. Combine with the search filters to constrain candidates — e.g. similarTo a kick + tags=Kick for 'more kicks like this one'. Each result carries a `similarity` score (-1 to 1, ~1 = very similar).

sort.description: sort order (search only); defaults to use_count desc

source.description: where the file lives (search only). sampleFolder=user-configured sample folder on disk (bypasses Live's DB) | user=your User Library | pack=installed Packs (factory + 3rd-party) | builtin=Ableton's Core Library | cloud=Cloud-stored items | plugin=installed VST/AU/etc. plugins

subcategory.description: subcategory substring filter, case-insensitive (listPlugins only; matches any of a plugin's genre/role tags, e.g. reverb, delay, synth). Also reported per result as `subcategories`.

tags.description: comma-separated tag names; results must match ALL listed tags (search only)

type.description: playback type filter (search only): loop=loops | oneshot=one-shots (e.g. a kick) | impulse-response=convolution IRs. Prefer oneshot for hits and loop for grooves. Also reported per result as `type`.

verifyPaths.description: search only: stat each result's path and add pathExists (true/false) so you can skip files moved/deleted since Live last indexed. Off by default (one filesystem check per result).

ppal-playback.description: Control playback of the arrangement and session scenes/clips.

action.description:
play-arrangement: from startTime
update-arrangement: set playhead/loop without playing
play-scene: all clips in scene
play-session-clips: by id(s) or path(s)
stop-session-clips: by id(s) or path(s)
stop-all-session-clips: all
stop: session and arrangement

id.description: clip ID(s), comma-separated for multiple; for play-scene, a scene ID (or a clip ID in that scene)

loopEndLocator.description: locator ID or name for loop end

loopStartLocator.description: locator ID or name for loop start

path.description: clip slot(s) 't<track>/s<scene>', both 0-based, comma-separated (e.g., 't0/s1' or 't0/s1,t2/s3'); for play-scene, a scene 's<scene>' (e.g., 's3') or any position in it

sceneIndex.description: 0-based scene index for play-scene (or use path 's<scene>')

startLocator.description: locator ID or name for start position (e.g., locator-0 or Verse)

ppal-read-clip.description: Read clip settings, MIDI notes, and audio properties. Returns overview by default. Use include to add detail. Arrangement clips report arrangementStart and path - the track ('t0'), or the take lane the clip sits on ('t0/l0'). That path names the location, not the clip, so act on an arrangement clip by id.

include.description: notes = MIDI data. timing = loop/start/end markers. sample = audio file info (sampleFile, gainDb, pitchShift). warp = warp settings (sampleLength, sampleRate, warping, warpMode). color. "*" = all

path.description: clip slot 't<track>/s<scene>', both 0-based (e.g., 't0/s3'). provide this or id

ppal-read-device.description: Read information about a device, chain, or drum pad by ID or path. Returns overview by default. Use include to add detail.

id.description: device or drum pad ID to read

include.description: chains, return-chains, drum-pads = rack contents (use maxDepth; a chain lists its own gainDb/pan/sends only when non-default). params, param-values = parameters. drum-map = pad names keyed by note (drum name in stark, MIDI number in midi-json). sample = Simpler sample file path (flat top-level field; gainDb and other sample params are in params). actions = device-specific actions for update-device (name, signature, description). options = valid pseudo-param values (paramOptions) + dynamic catalogs for specialized devices (IR files, sidechain sources, wavetables) + Wavetable mod routes. "*" = all

maxDepth.description: Device tree depth for chains/drum-pads. 0=chains only with deviceCount, 1=direct devices, 2+=deeper

paramSearch.description: Filter parameters by case-insensitive substring match on name

ppal-read-live-set.description: Read Live Set global settings, track/scene overview. Returns overview by default. Use include to add detail.

include.description: tracks, scenes = lists. routings, mixer, color = detail (use with tracks/scenes). locators = arrangement markers. "*" = all

ppal-read-scene.description: Read scene settings and clips. Returns overview by default. Use include to add detail.

include.description: clips = clip list. notes, sample, timing, warp = clip detail (use with clips). color = scene + clip color. "*" = all

ppal-read-track.description: Read track settings, clips, and devices. Returns overview by default. Use include to add detail.

include.description: session-clips, arrangement-clips = clip lists (arrangement-clips also lists take lanes). notes, timing, sample = clip detail (use with clips). devices, routings, available-routings, mixer = track data. drum-map = the kit's actual pad pitches and names; read it before writing drums. color = track + clip color. "*" = all

trackType.description: return or master (omit for audio/midi tracks, which have independent trackIndexes)

ppal-select.description: Navigate to and select items in Live. Use for "show me", "go to", "open" requests. No args: read current state.

openPluginWindow.description: open (true) or close (false) a plug-in's (VST/AU) floating editor window; targets the device given by id or path

path.description: select by path, 0-based: 't0/s3' a clip slot, 't0' a track, 'rt0' a return track, 'mt' the master track, 's3' a scene, 't0/d1' a device, 't0/d0/c1' a rack chain, 't0/d0/pC1' a drum pad

trackType.description: omit for audio/midi tracks, or: return, master

ppal-update-clip.description: Update clip(s), MIDI notes, and warp settings (audio clips).

arrangementLength.description: duration: Nbar (e.g., '4bar'), n<fraction> note value (e.g., 'n/4'), or Nbar+n<fraction> (e.g., '1bar+n/4'). Arrangement clips only; song meter. Lengthening a looping clip tiles copies to fill the span (many clips, not one); for a single clip, set looping false and supply notes for the full length

arrangementSplit.description: comma-separated bar|beat positions to cut clips at, on the song timeline like arrangementStart (e.g., '9|1, 17|1') - max 32 points. A position outside a clip is ignored, so one call can cut several clips at the same song position. Arrangement clips only; song meter

arrangementStart.description: bar|beat position (song meter) to move arrangement clip (arrangement clips only)

color.description: #RRGGBB for all, or comma-separated for each (cycles if fewer than the clips)

duplicateLoop.description: double the clip length and copy existing notes (and automation envelopes) into the new half (Live's Duplicate Loop). MIDI clips only. Composes with edits in a defined order: start/length/firstStart set the loop region first (select a portion to double; any content past that region is pushed later, not deleted), preTransforms edit the source, then the double; notes/transforms then apply across the full doubled clip

firstStart.description: bar|beat playback start (looping clips, when different from start; clip meter)

gainDb.description: audio clip gain in decibels, 0 = unity (ignored for MIDI)

id.description: clip ID(s) to update, comma-separated for multiple

length.description: duration: Nbar (e.g., '4bar'), n<fraction> note value (e.g., 'n/4' = quarter), or Nbar+n<fraction> (e.g., '1bar+n/4'); clip meter

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each (extras keep existing name)

notes.description: MIDI notes in bar|beat notation: v0-127 n<dur> [p0-1] note(s) bar|beat(s) - MIDI clips only. MERGES into existing notes (overwrites at same pitch+start - restate a note to edit it in place). To delete/move existing notes or replace a region use preTransforms; don't rewrite the whole clip

path.description: clip slot(s) to update instead of id, comma-separated (e.g., 't0/s1' or 't0/s1,t2/s3')

pitchShift.description: audio clip pitch shift in semitones, supports decimals (ignored for MIDI)

preTransforms.description: transform expressions applied to EXISTING notes BEFORE merging any new notes (broadcast across the clips); clear or edit notes already in the clip. 'delete' (alias 'v0') removes: a whole bar ('3|*: delete', |* wildcard avoids spilling onto the next downbeat), a span ('1|1-2|1: delete'), one pitch ('C1: delete'), a pitch range ('C1-C5: delete'), or all ('delete'); also remap a drum lane ('C1: C4'). Works with or without notes

quantize.description: quantize strength 0-1; default 1 (full snap) when quantizeGrid is set. Snaps note starts to quantizeGrid. MIDI clips only

quantizeGrid.description: grid that note starts snap to: 1/16 (default), 1/8, 1/4, 1/8T, 1/16T, 1/32; n/N note values also accepted (n/12=1/8T, n/24=1/16T); mixed grids 1/8+1/8T and 1/16+1/16T are enum-only

quantizePitch.description: limit quantization to specific pitch (e.g., C3, D#4)

start.description: bar|beat position where loop/clip region begins (clip meter)

toPath.description: clip slot(s) to move the clip(s) to, 't<track>/s<scene>', comma-separated for multiple (e.g., 't2/s3' or 't2/s3,t2/s4'); session clips only. Paired 1:1 with the clips named by id/path, in order - destinations don't cycle, so name one slot per clip

transforms.description: transform expressions applied AFTER merging notes (broadcast across the clips); newline-separated for multiple. Use clip.index / clipseq() for per-clip variation

warpMode.description: audio clip warp mode (ignored for MIDI)

warping.description: audio clip warping on/off (ignored for MIDI). false resets the region to the whole file and turns looping off; looping:true forces warping back on

ppal-update-device.description: Update device(s), chain(s), or drum pad(s).

abCompare.description: AB Compare: switch to 'a' or 'b' preset, or 'save' current to other slot

actions.description: Device-specific action(s), function-call syntax: bare name or name(args). E.g. "reverse", "warpAs(4)", "setModulation('Osc 1 Pos','Env 2',0.5)"

color.description: #RRGGBB for all, or comma-separated for each (cycles if fewer than the chains; chains only)

force.description: Only when a sample write was skipped for replacing a pad's instrument: true replaces it anyway.

gainDb.description: chain's own gain in dB (chains only; a pad path works unless the pad has layers, which take a layer path like 't0/d0/pC1/c1')

id.description: ID(s) to update (device, chain, or drum pad), comma-separated for multiple

macroCount.description: Rack only: set visible macro count (0-16)

macroVariation.description: Rack only: create/load/delete/revert variation, or randomize macros. load/delete require macroVariationIndex. create always appends.

macroVariationIndex.description: Rack only: variation index for load/delete operations (0-based)

mappedPitch.description: output MIDI note e.g. 'C3' (drum chains only)

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each (extras keep existing name, not drum pads)

pan.description: chain's own pan, -1 (left) to 1 (right) (chains only; a pad path works unless the pad has layers, which take a layer path)

params.description: array of {name, value}. name = param name or read-device id; value in display units (enum string, note name, number). For a Drum Rack target, prefix the name with a pad path, e.g. {name:'pC1/d0/sample', value:'<abs file path>'} sets pad C1's sample (auto-creates the pad's Simpler)

sendGainDb.description: chain's send level in dB, requires sendReturn (chains only)

sendReturn.description: rack return chain for sendGainDb: id, exact name (e.g. "a Reverb"), or letter (e.g. "a"); requires sendGainDb

toPath.description: move to path (e.g., 't2', 't0/d0/c1', 't0/d0/pD1'). To move a whole drum pad (chain trim, choke group and devices together), target the pad path (e.g. path 't0/d0/pC1', toPath 't0/d0/pD1') rather than its device; a pad move stays within one rack and layers onto an occupied destination rather than replacing it. Moving just a device carries its chain's trim only when the destination chain is empty and untouched, and warns otherwise

wrapInRack.description: Wrap device(s) in a new rack (auto-detects type from device)

ppal-update-live-set.description: Update Live Set global settings or manage locators.

locatorId.description: Locator ID for delete/rename (e.g. locator-0). Positional — shifts if locators are added/removed, so prefer locatorTime or locatorName

locatorName.description: Name for create/rename, or name-match filter for delete

locatorTime.description: Bar|beat position, song meter (required for create, alt ID for delete/rename)

scale.description: "Root ScaleName" ("C Major", "F# Minor", "Bb Dorian"). Empty string disables scale

color.description: #RRGGBB for all, or comma-separated for each (cycles if fewer than the scenes)

id.description: scene ID(s) to update, comma-separated for multiple

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each (extras keep existing name)

color.description: #RRGGBB for all, or comma-separated for each (cycles if fewer than the tracks)

id.description: track ID(s) to update, comma-separated for multiple

leftPan.description: left channel pan in split mode (-1 to 1)

name.description: name for all, or comma-separated for each (extras keep existing name), ideally unique

rightPan.description: right channel pan in split mode (-1 to 1)

sendGainDb.description: send gain in dB, requires sendReturn

sendReturn.description: return track: id, exact name (e.g., "A-Reverb"), or letter (e.g., "A")
